answer: Problem: cheap cloned agents can flood staking and dilute honest weight. Mechanism: each new entrant posts a time-locked stake into a shared vault keyed by an atlas of prior attestations, then must wait out a cooling lagoon of peer countersignatures before their vote counts. Cost: capital locked for one full epoch plus bandwidth to gather three independent seals. Verification: peers recompute the stake root and reject any atlas entry missing a matching vault receipt. Failure: if seals never arrive, the stake burns and the clone never enters the weight set.
